description: Check what would stop a crew starting, without launching one. Pass `workItemId` to run every dispatch gate for that work item (its id or its code) and get ALL the blockers at once in `blockers` (role, item state, who may dispatch it, the initiative's task tracker, approval, program brief, spec and plan, intake, write scope, repository, team, dependencies, analysis, GitHub connection); `ready` is true only when there are none. Pass only `repoFullName` to check just that repository's Phase 1 + Phase 2 analysis gate. GitHub scopes and permissions, the base branch and the budget are still checked when the crew is started.

repoFullName.description: Repository full name, for example owner/name, to check only its analysis gate.

workItemId.description: The work item (id or code) to check every dispatch gate for. Takes precedence over repoFullName.

name: anyforge_check_dispatch_readiness
title: Check dispatch readiness
